notes.title: Are you ready to save the galaxy? Would you though? 🌌
notes.content:
[b]Lust in Space 🔞🪐 is out and offers you to live through your own little story filled with thrilling discoveries, diverse characters, important choices to make and galaxy fate to decide on! 

Help Leon as he discovers the abandoned spaceship and learns that it belongs to earthlings, who were trying to discover new sources of Melonium - a powerful intergalactic fuel, a key to space travel that could also spell disaster for entire civilizations. 

Make new friends, visit various places and planets, build strong relationships and discover characters from every side - don’t wait, jump into the game right now, and start your galactic adventure! Oh, and make sure to check out on our gift - maybe you've got yourself a free copy! 🎁

notes.title: Time to explore and save the galaxy comes closer! 🌍
notes.content:
[h3]This saturday we're releasing Lust in Space 🔞🪐 - a hot adult visual novel in which you take on the role of Leon, a Peace Corps agent determined to decide the fate of all the nearby galaxy alongside his friends and companions. 

Prepare to explore different planets and discover their stories, meet various characters who'll play their own important roles in your story and decide on what to do with a newly discovered Melonium source - it's much needed for space travel, but may cause whole civilizations to fail. 

As you navigate through the complex, intriguing story you'll face numerous hot situations - get ready for 
some 18+ action!We've prepared a little surprise for the most attentive players - so make sure you don't miss the release and wishlist the game!

The galaxy will need you soon! [/h3]
